arxiv-1612-02495.title: An initial investigation of the performance of GPU-based swept time-space decomposition
arxiv-1612-02495.creator: Daniel Magee and Kyle E. Niemeyer Oregon State University, Corvallis OR 97331-6001, USA
arxiv-1612-02495.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by Daniel Magee and Kyle E. Niemeyer Oregon State University, Corvallis OR 97331-6001, USA. Simulations of physical phenomena are essential to the expedient design of precision components in aerospace and other high-tech industries. These phenomena are often described by mathematical models involving partial differential equations (PDEs) without exact solutions. Modern design problems require simulations with a level of resolution that is difficult to achieve in a reasonable amount of time even in effectively parallelized solvers.

arxiv-2004-05377.title: Competition Between Intermodal Modulation Instability and Kerr Beam Self-cleaning in Graded-index Multimode Fiber
arxiv-2004-05377.creator: Partha Mondal, Shailendra K. Varshney
arxiv-2004-05377.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Partha Mondal, Shailendra K. Varshney. We report the suppression of intermodal modulation instability peaks as a consequence of Kerr induced self beam-cleaning in a 90m long graded-index multimode optical fiber under various specific launching conditions. Output spectrum and the modal beam profiles for three modes ( L ​ P 01 LP_{01} , L ​ P 11 LP_{11} and L ​ P 21 LP_{21} ) have been recorded for several values of pump pulse energy.

arxiv-2012-01422.title: On Lie’s classification of subalgebras of vector fields on the plane Thanks: FM is Visiting Professor at UNSW for 2020
arxiv-2012-01422.creator: Hassan Azad, Indranil Biswas, Fazal M. Mahomed, Said Waqas Shah
arxiv-2012-01422.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Hassan Azad, Indranil Biswas, Fazal M. Mahomed, Said Waqas Shah. A brief proof of Lie’s classification of solvable algebras of vector fields on the plane is given. The proof uses basic representation theory and PDEs. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 17B66, 32M25, 17B30 1. Introduction The aim of this note is to give a brief proof of Lie’s classification of all solvable Lie algebras of vector fields on the plane.

arxiv-2107-00761.title: On the Bike Spreading Problem
arxiv-2107-00761.creator: Elia Costa, Francesco Silvestri
arxiv-2107-00761.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Elia Costa, Francesco Silvestri. A free-floating bike-sharing system (FFBSS) is a dockless rental system where an individual can borrow a bike and returns it anywhere, within the service area. To improve the rental service, available bikes should be distributed over the entire service area: a customer leaving from any position is then more likely to find a near bike and then to use the service.

arxiv-2107-14395.title: Improving the precision of weak-value-amplification with two cascaded Michelson interferometers based on Vernier-effect
arxiv-2107-14395.creator: Jing-Hui Huang 1, Fei-Fan He 1, Xue-Ying Duan 2,3,4, Guang-Jun Wang 2,3,4, Xiang-Yun Hu 1
arxiv-2107-14395.description: Abstract A modified-weak-value-amplification(MWVA) technique of measuring the mirror’s velocity based on the Vernier-effect has been proposed. We have demonstrated with sensitivity-enhanced and the higher signal-to-noise ratio( SNR {\rm SNR} ) by using two cascaded Michelson interferometers. These two interferometers are composed of similar optical structures.

arxiv-2204-11473.title: Mitigation of Cyberattacks through Battery Storage for Stable Microgrid Operation PubID: pubid: 978-1-5708-0592-5/22/$31.00 ©2022 IEEE
arxiv-2204-11473.creator: Ioannis Zografopoulos 1 , Panagiotis Karamichailidis 1 , Andreas T. Procopiou 2 , Fei Teng 3 , George C. Konstantopoulos 4 , Charalambos Konstantinou 1
arxiv-2204-11473.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ioannis Zografopoulos 1 , Panagiotis Karamichailidis 1 , Andreas T. Procopiou 2 , Fei Teng 3 , George C. Konstantopoulos 4 , Charalambos Konstantinou 1. In this paper, we present a mitigation methodology that leverages battery energy storage system (BESS) resources in coordination with microgrid (MG) ancillary services to maintain power system operations during cyberattacks.

arxiv-2305-10386.title: On the difference between Fixed-Order and Contour-Improved Perturbation Theory
arxiv-2305-10386.creator: Maarten Golterman,
arxiv-2305-10386.description: Abstract Using standard mathematical methods for asymptotic series and the large- \beta_{0} approximation, we define a Minimum Distance between the Fixed-Order perturbative series and the Contour-Improved perturbative series in the strong coupling \alpha_{s} for finite-energy sum rules as applied to hadronic \tau decays.

arxiv-2504-19306.title: Spatial-Sign based High dimensional Change Point Inference
arxiv-2504-19306.creator: Jixuan Liu, Long Feng, Liuhua Peng, Zhaojun WangSchool of Statistics and Data Science, KLMDASR, LEBPS, and LPMC, Nankai University, University of Melbourne
arxiv-2504-19306.description: Abstract High-dimensional changepoint inference, adaptable to diverse alternative scenarios, has attracted significant attention in recent years. In this paper, we propose an adaptive and robust approach to changepoint testing. Specifically, by generalizing the classical mean-based cumulative sum (CUSUM) statistic, we construct CUSUM statistics based on spatial medians and spatial signs.

arxiv-2505-12052.title: Deformation and differential rotation in slowly rotating young intermediate-mass stars
arxiv-2505-12052.creator: Subrata Kumar Panda, Shravan Hanasoge
arxiv-2505-12052.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Subrata Kumar Panda, Shravan Hanasoge. Asteroseismology, the study of stellar vibrations, is a method which can probe the structure deformation and internal rotation of stars. Salient among the seismic inferences of rotation from TESS observations are TIC 408165734, whose equatorial rotation rate is 10% faster than the pole, and TIC 307930890, which has significant radial shear and shows a decreasing spin rate outward through its envelope.

arxiv-2508-10868.title: TexVerse: A Universe of 3D Objects with High-Resolution Textures
arxiv-2508-10868.creator: Yibo Zhang, Li Zhang, Rui Ma, Nan Cao
arxiv-2508-10868.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yibo Zhang, Li Zhang, Rui Ma, Nan Cao. We introduce TexVerse, a large-scale 3D dataset featuring high-resolution textures. While recent advances in large-scale 3D datasets have enhanced high-resolution geometry generation, creating high-resolution textures end-to-end remains underexplored due to the lack of suitable datasets. TexVerse fills this gap with a curated collection of over 858K unique high-resolution 3D models sourced from Sketchfab, including more than 158K models with physically based rendering (PBR) materials.

arxiv-2509-25065.title: Cause-and-effect approach to turbulence forecasting
arxiv-2509-25065.creator: Álvaro Martínez-Sánchez, Adrián Lozano-Durán
arxiv-2509-25065.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Álvaro Martínez-Sánchez, Adrián Lozano-Durán. Purpose – Traditional modeling techniques for forecasting turbulence often rely on correlation-based criteria, which may select variables that correlate with the target without truly driving its dynamics. This limits model interpretability, generalization, and efficiency. The purpose of this study is to overcome these limitations by introducing an observational causality-based approach to input selection that identifies the variables responsible for the future evolution of a target quantity while disregarding non-causal factors.

arxiv-2512-07960.title: Forecasting Dark Matter Subhalo Constraints from Stellar Streams using Implicit Likelihood Inference
arxiv-2512-07960.creator: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
arxiv-2512-07960.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration. The evidence for dark matter (DM) remains compelling, although attempts to understand its particle nature remain inconclusive. One promising method to study DM is detecting DM subhalos through their gravitational interactions with stellar streams. In this study, we apply Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) to constrain subhalo interaction parameters, including mass, scale radius, velocity, and encounter geometry, from stellar stream kinematics.

arxiv-2601-23020.title: Uncovering Hidden Inclusions of Vulnerable Dependencies in Real-World Java Projects
arxiv-2601-23020.creator: Stefan Schott, Serena Elisa Ponta, Wolfram Fischer, Jonas Klauke, Eric Bodden
arxiv-2601-23020.description: Abstract . Open-source software (OSS) dependencies are a dominant component of modern software code bases. Using proven and well-tested OSS components lets developers reduce development time and cost while improving quality. However, heavy reliance on open-source software also introduces significant security risks, including the incorporation of known vulnerabilities into the codebase.

arxiv-2602-24211.title: SINGLE PARAMETER MODEL FOR GALAXY ROTATION CURVES
arxiv-2602-24211.creator: Sophia N. Cisneros *, Rich Ott, Meagan Crowley, Amy Roberts, Marcus Paz
arxiv-2602-24211.description: Abstract One key piece of evidence for dark matter is the rotation-curve problem: the disagreement between measured galactic rotation curves and their luminous mass. A novel solution to this problem is presented here, in a model that predicts observed Doppler-shifted spectra based only on the luminous matter estimates and one free model parameter.

arxiv-2606-22914.title: PromptDyG: Test-Time Prompt Adaptation on Dynamic Graphs
arxiv-2606-22914.creator: Guoguo Ai, Chaoxi Niu, Hui Yan, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Yew-Soon Ong, Guansong Pang

europmc-pmc6318916.title: Achondroplasia: a comprehensive clinical review.
europmc-pmc6318916.creator: Pauli RM.
europmc-pmc6318916.description: Achondroplasia is the most common of the skeletal dysplasias that result in marked short stature (dwarfism). Although its clinical and radiologic phenotype has been described for more than 50 years, there is still a great deal to be learned about the medical issues that arise...

nasa-tm-19700026407-study-of-lem-abort-t.creator: Unknown
nasa-tm-19700026407-study-of-lem-abort-t.description: NASA technical report. Transfer characteristics for lunar module from descent and circular parking orbits

plos-pone-0330578.creator: Qingya Pan, Shengjie Luan, Fuke Zhang, Linzhao Tian, Guishu Wu, Yizhong Fan

plos-pone-0349196.title: Real world experience with cyclin dependent kinase inhibitors in metastatic breast cancer in India
plos-pone-0349196.creator: Anindya Mukherjee, Pankaj Goyal, Rupal Tripathi, Sumit Goyal, Ullas Batra, Vineet Talwar, Varun Goel, Arpit Jain
plos-pone-0349196.description: Real world experience with cyclin dependent kinase inhibitors in metastatic breast cancer in India

pmc-10545770.title: Association of high intra-patient variability in tacrolimus exposure with calcineurin inhibitor nephrotoxicity in kidney transplantation
pmc-10545770.creator: Hyokee Kim, Ahram Han, Sanghyun Ahn, Seung-Kee Min, Jongwon Ha, Sangil Min
pmc-10545770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Tacrolimus intra-patient variability (IPV) is a novel predictive marker for long-term kidney transplantation outcomes. We examined the association between IPV and calcineurin inhibitor (CNI) nephrotoxicity and the impact of pharmacogenes on CNI nephrotoxicity and IPV. Among kidney transplant recipients at our hospital between January 2013 and December 2015, the records of 80 patients who underwent 1-year protocol renal allograft biopsy and agreed to donate blood samples for genetic analysis were retrospectively reviewed.

pmc-10725554.title: Diagnosis and treatment of post-cholecystectomy diarrhoea
pmc-10725554.creator: Rang-Lang Huang, Wen-Kai Huang, Xiang-Yi Xiao, Lin-Feng Ma, He-Zi-Rui Gu, Guo-Ping Yang
pmc-10725554.description: The incidence of cholecystitis is relatively high in developed countries and may usually be attributed to gallstones, the treatment for which involves complete surgical removal of the gallbladder (cholecystectomy). Bile acids produced following cholecystectomy continue to flow into the duodenum but are poorly absorbed by the colon.

pmc-10834647.title: Brentuximab vedotin as a bridge to combination chemotherapy in gray zone lymphoma with severe liver impairment: a case report
pmc-10834647.creator: Roshan Asrani, Turgot Bora Cengiz, Bruce E. Petersen, Theodora Anagnostou, Joshua D. Brody
pmc-10834647.description: BackgroundGray zone lymphoma (GZL) is a rare lymphoma subtype characterized by features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL). The optimal first-line treatment for GZL remains undefined, particularly for patients with poor performance status or baseline organ impairment.

pmc-11510005.title: Resveratrol and Its Natural Analogs Mitigate Immune Dysregulation and Oxidative Imbalance in the Endometriosis Niche Simulated in a Co-Culture System of Endometriotic Cells and Macrophages
pmc-11510005.creator: Agata Gołąbek-Grenda, Wojciech Juzwa, Mariusz Kaczmarek, Anna Olejnik, Antoni Sureda
pmc-11510005.description: Background: Inflammation and immune cell dysfunction are critical facilitators of endometriosis pathophysiology. Macrophages are renowned for stimulating lesion growth, vascularization, innervation, and pain generation. By combining macrophages and endometriotic cells, we determined if resveratrol and its natural analogs can target the immune dysregulation and oxidative imbalance in endometriosis.

pmc-11572953.title: Identification and characterisation of colistin-resistant Acinetobacter colistiniresistens co-producing IMP-1 and OXA-58 carbapenemases
pmc-11572953.creator: Satoshi Nishida, Yasuo Ono
pmc-11572953.description: BackgroundCarbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter is of increasing global concern because infections are challenging to treat with standard antibiotics. Here, we identified a previously uncharacterised Acinetobacter sp. clinical isolate as Acinetobacter colistiniresistens co-producing IMP-1 and OXA-58. We also examined expression of genes related to antibiotic susceptibility and drug resistance, including blaIMP.

pmc-11692998.title: EXPLORING THE LANDSCAPE OF GENERATIVE AI AND LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN ALZHEIMER AND DEMENTIAS RESEARCH
pmc-11692998.creator: Duo Wei, Jeannine Elmasri, Bianca Hernandez, Riya Goyal, David Burdick
pmc-11692998.description: With the introduction of ChatGPT in November 2022 and Google Bard (now Gemini) in March 2023, the artificial intelligence (AI) landscape has undergone a significant and rapid evolution. An in-depth scoping review was utilized to investigate the application of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLM) in research on Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) among older adults.

pmc-12373731.title: Domain general noise reduction for time series signals with Noisereduce
pmc-12373731.creator: Tim Sainburg, Asaf Zorea
pmc-12373731.description: Extracting signals from noisy backgrounds is a fundamental problem in signal processing across a variety of domains. In this paper, we introduce Noisereduce, an algorithm for minimizing noise across a variety of domains, including speech, bioacoustics, neurophysiology, and seismology. Noisereduce uses spectral gating to estimate a frequency-domain mask that effectively separates signals from noise.

pmc-12537698.title: Oxycardiorespirograms in neonatal monitoring—current gaps and future potential of artificial intelligence: a mini-review
pmc-12537698.creator: Kora Helm, Alexandra Epp, Michael Gerstlauer, Mathias Kaspar, Ludwig C. Hinske, Melanie L. Conrad, Fabian B. Fahlbusch
pmc-12537698.description: The neonatal oxycardiorespirogram (OCRG) captures synchronized, multi-channel recordings of respiratory patterns, heart rate variability, transcutaneous oxygen tension, and relative skin perfusion in neonates. As a non-invasive, point-of-care modality, OCRG is routinely used to assess cardiorespiratory stability in high-risk infants, particularly preterm neonates at risk for apnea, bradycardia, and desaturation.

pmc-12608099.title: Understanding the feasibility of yoga and compassion meditation for stress management in mothers of children with intellectual disabilities in Nepal: a qualitative exploration
pmc-12608099.creator: Namrata Pradhan, Gørill Haugan, Poonam Rishal, Jennifer Infanti
pmc-12608099.description: BackgroundMothers caring for children with intellectual disabilities often experience high levels of stress and mental health challenges, underscoring the need for targeted health-promoting interventions.ObjectiveThis qualitative study explores the feasibility of brief yoga and compassion meditation training for stress management among mothers of children with intellectual disabilities in Nepal, focusing on their experiences and insights.

pmc-12653895.title: Fructose Malabsorption, Gut Microbiota and Clinical Consequences: A Narrative Review of the Current Evidence
pmc-12653895.creator: Catarina D. Simões, Ana Sofia Sousa, Sofia Fernandes, Amélia Sarmento
pmc-12653895.description: Fructose malabsorption is characterized as the incomplete absorption of fructose in the small intestine. Fructose is one of the most common monosaccharides in the human diet. The purpose of this review is to provide an updated overview of insights into the relationship between high-fructose diet, fructose malabsorption, gut microbiota and clinical consequences.

pmc-12660109.title: Genotype by environment interaction for growth traits of families of Acacia melanoxylon based on BLUP and GGE biplot
pmc-12660109.creator: Shao-Ning Ruan, Liu-Ben Chen, Bo Zhang, Wei-Hao Zhang, Guo-Chang Ding, Guang-Qiu Cao, Long-Tai Ye, Shi-Bin He, Dong-Yang Shen, Qiang Yan
pmc-12660109.description: Acacia melanoxylon is a high-quality timber species renowned for its superior heartwood and wide global use. To assess its stability, adaptability, and productivity in Fujian Province, China, a regional trial involving 47 A. melanoxylon families was conducted across four sites.

pmc-12693994.title: From sensory to perceptual manifolds: The twist of neural geometry
pmc-12693994.creator: Heng Ma, Longsheng Jiang, Tao Liu, Jia Liu
pmc-12693994.description: Classification constitutes a fundamental cognitive challenge for both biological and artificial intelligence systems. Here, we investigated how the brain categorizes stimuli that are not linearly separable in the physical world by analyzing the geometry of neural manifolds formed by macaque V2 neurons during a classification task involving motion-induced illusory contours.

pmc-13085389.title: NAIL-G: a conceptual best-fit framework for nursing ai literacy and governance anchored in socio-technical safety science
pmc-13085389.creator: Fatma M. Ibrahim, Ghada Shahrour, Israa A. M. Abuijlan, Amal Mohammed Abdallah, Asmaa Alsuwayed, Abdulkarem Radhi Alanazi
pmc-13085389.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence is reshaping health care delivery and education, but nurses lack discipline-specific guidance that integrates artificial intelligence literacy with socio-technical safety and governance. Existing AI literacy and digital competence models are often generic and do not reflect nursing standards, work systems or responsibilities for patient safety and equity.

pmc-13553734.title: Bidirectional relations of alcohol demand with alcohol use and problems in community adults: Findings from a longitudinal observational cohort study
pmc-13553734.creator: Sophie G Coelho, Kyla L Belisario, Matthew T Keough, James MacKillop
pmc-13553734.description: Behavioral economic theory posits that the relative reinforcing value of alcohol (i.e., demand) prospectively predicts alcohol use behaviors, although this has rarely been examined longitudinally. This study examined bidirectional associations of alcohol demand with alcohol use and problems over time. Community adults (N = 1,395; M age = 34.32, 59.
